evidence.observation: 3.04 Torr at start of growth, typical of the ramp
rose steadily to 3.266 Torr (about +0.056 Torr per 120 s) with Ar flow constant
rose steadily to 30.8 ppm alongside pressure; this fits air coming in, not a blocked exhaust (argon backing up would not raise O2)
100.6 sccm, on setpoint, so the flow controller is not the cause
749.9 °C, stable at setpoint, so the thermal side is normal

args.missing_evidence: A leak-rate check (isolate the tube and watch whether pressure rises), or a helium sniff test at the flanges and O-rings, would confirm the leak. The sample has not been characterized yet.
